author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಚಾಟಿ ಬೀಸುವ ವಿಧಿಗೆ ಜೀವನವು ಬುಗುರಿಯಹು
ದಾಟಿದರೆ ಪರಿಧಿಯನು ವಿಧಿಸುವುದು ಶಿಕ್ಷೆ
ಮೀಟುತಿರೆ ಸದ್ಗುಣವ ಜೀವನವನೆತ್ತರಿಸೆ
ಮೇಟಿಯಹು ಜೀವನಕೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Life is a spinning top for fate that cracks the whip;
cross the line, and fate hands out punishment;
but keep plucking the strings of virtue to raise your life,
and virtue becomes life’s central pillar, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: We are spun about by fate, and it punishes those who overstep. Yet steady goodness lifts a life and becomes the post it turns around.
